youtube_title: Stopped Your SIP When Market Fell? Big Mistake 📉 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Market down 20%, SIP red, STOP SIP. Sounds safe. It's not.

In a fall, the same SIP amount buys MORE units. COVID 2020: Nifty 50 fell about 38%, from ~12,360 (Jan) to ~7,610 (23 Mar). By November 2020 it was back above the old high, and by end-2021 above 17,000. SIPs that kept running bought cheap units all through the fall; those who stopped missed them. Past recoveries are not a guarantee.

Rule: SIP is for 5+ years. Don't stop it in a fall. Stop only if your goal or income changes.
Moral: A market fall is your SIP's discount season.

Source: NSE Nifty 50 closing data (2020-21).
Education only, not investment advice.
